Hi Alicia —

Great speaking with you yesterday. Per our call, I pulled together a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to help align stakeholders, milestones, and decision owners as we scope the pilot and work toward a proposed close in early November. Attached are two starter artifacts: a MAP template (editable) and our suggested evaluation criteria doc you can share with your clinical and procurement teams.

High-level proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): MAP kickoff + stakeholder roster finalization
- Week 1: Technical kickoff + test-data checklist
- Weeks 2–4: Pilot execution (small cohort) + weekly check-ins
- Week 5: Quality review + executive summary prep
- Week 6: Procurement + legal review
- Week 7: Final decision & procurement signoff (target close: 2026-11-03)

Ask from you today: can you confirm a single champion we should route approvals through, and any non-negotiable internal deadlines (e.g., procurement blackout windows or fiscal close constraints)? If it helps, I can share the MAP in Google Drive and start a simple RACI column so responsibilities are visible.

Quick logistics:
- Attachments: MAP_Template.xlsx, evaluation_criteria.docx (attached)
- Collaborative folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPfolder
- DocuSign for standard SOW/terms will be shared once scope is locked: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456

I copied Karthik (solutions) and Monica (CSM) — Karthik can run a short technical kickoff and Monica will own success metrics and the weekly check-ins.

Would you be available for a 30-minute MAP kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT (I’ll send a calendar invite if that works)?

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — and hi Alicia, excited to get started. A couple technical items to flag ahead of tomorrow’s kickoff so we can use time efficiently:

1) Pilot scope: will the pilot run on de-identified extracts or on production-access to a narrow dataset? If de-identified, we’ll need a sample CSV schema and a short data dictionary.
2) Latency/throughput expectations: please share expected concurrency and max response latency targets for the clinical workflows (so we can recommend batching/quantization configs).
3) Security/compliance: we’ll prepare a short SOC2/PenTest evidence pack but would appreciate any specific controls or vendor questionnaires you expect.

I’ve added a one-page tech checklist to the Drive folder (see link in Marissa’s note). If you prefer, I can run a 15-minute technical deep-dive immediately after the kickoff with your data lead.
